name: A Jury of Pigeons
summary: Tamsin Ledger will not allow a mob to try anyone without a quorum, a docket and sworn witnesses, and the only witnesses are pigeons.

stages.journal: Tamsin Ledger is auditing the mob from a crate and has found it out of order: no quorum, no docket, no sworn witnesses. She needs a jury, and every free party member has just been drafted.
stages.hint: Help Tamsin hold the hearing: a docket from Wendel, a quorum, and an oath from the pigeons.

stages.journal: The hearing is in session on the Founder's Round. The mob sits in rows, bewildered, while Tamsin reads out the charges against a pigeon.
The mob adjourned for the night, charm and all, because Tamsin refused to let anyone leave before the minutes were read.
The charm broke before the hearing could sit. Tamsin filed the minutes of the hearing that did not happen, and the pigeons were discharged without a stain.
Tamsin was left holding a docket and a gavel, and the mob ran her hearing right over.
